headline: Growth businesses to drive earnings recovery

highlights: We expect improving scale and operating leverage in Paints and B2B E-commerce, along with a gradual recovery in core businesses, to drive earnings growth over the medium term.
Birla Opus to gain market share: We project Birla Opus to sustain a strong growth, supported by expanding distribution, improving brand acceptance and the price gap with peers narrowing down.
Management targets ~50% revenue growth in H2FY27 and double- digit revenue market share, which we believe could strengthen its competitive positioning.
Birla Pivot nearing profitability: We anticipate continued scale-up in Birla Pivot, with the management targeting FY27 revenue of over INR 120 Bn and breakeven in H2FY27.

We apply a 25% holding-company discount to subsidiaries and investments and arrive at a target price of INR 3,740 Key Risks: Slower-than-expected market-share gains and profitability ramp-up in Paints and Birla Pivot, elevated input cost and weaker-than- expected pricing across core businesses.
